# Medialane

> Open protocol for intellectual property registration, licensing, and trade. Deployed on Starknet Mainnet. Governed by MDLN token holders.

Medialane is a decentralized, permissionless infrastructure for programmable IP. Creators register any creative work as a smart-contract-backed NFT with automatic Berne Convention copyright protection valid in 181 countries. Assets can be licensed, sold, traded, or remixed with attribution chains recorded immutably onchain.

## MDLN Token

- **Supply:** 21,000,000 fixed (no inflation)
- **Standard:** ERC-20 with ERC20Votes + ERC20Permit
- **Chain:** Ethereum Mainnet (bridgeable to Starknet via StarkGate)
- **Treasury:** 100% DAO-controlled — no VC allocation, no team allocation
- **Distribution:** 2.1M operational runway + 18.9M vesting (9-year linear, 2.1M/year to DAO treasury)
- **Governance:** 1 MDLN = 1 vote on Snapshot (https://snapshot.org/#/s:medialane.eth)
- **Vesting start:** Gnosis Safe multisig controls; proposals required to spend
- **Trade:** Uniswap (Ethereum), Ekubo (Starknet)
- **Bridge:** StarkGate (https://starkgate.starknet.io)

---

## Governance

- **Legal structure:**  (United States)
- **Voting platform:** Snapshot (off-chain, gasless)
- **Proposal threshold:** 100 MDLN to submit
- **Voting period:** Minimum 5 days
- **Quorum:** Defined per proposal category
- **Execution:** Multisig signers execute passed proposals
- **Amendment threshold:** >66% supermajority for Constitution/Charter changes

### Membership Tiers

| Tier | Requirement | Rights |
|------|------------|--------|
| Observer | 1+ MDLN | View proposals, community access |
| Contributor | 100+ MDLN | Vote + submit proposals |
| Guardian | 1,000+ MDLN | Council nomination, working group leadership |

---

## Platform Features

### Create
- **Mint digital asset** — Register creative work as programmable NFT, 12 IP types, gasless, IPFS metadata
- **Create Collection** — Deploy branded ERC-721 or ERC-1155 collections via factory contracts
- **Remix & License** — Create licensed derivatives with onchain attribution graph

### Marketplace
- **Fixed-price listings** — ERC-721 and ERC-1155 supported
- **Offers (bids)** — Any wallet can offer on any indexed NFT
- **Counter-offers** — Sellers can negotiate with a counter-bid
- **Cart checkout** — Batch buy multiple items in one atomic multicall
- **Currencies:** USDC, USDT, ETH, STRK, WBTC
- **Fee:** 1% on completed sales → DAO treasury

### Launchpad
- **Collection Drop** — Timed mint with supply cap, allowlist, per-wallet limits
- **POP Protocol** — Soulbound (non-transferable) proof-of-participation credentials
- **ERC-1155 Edition** — Multi-copy editions for music, publications, prints

### IP Protection
- **Berne Convention** — onchain timestamp = copyright proof in 181 countries
- **Programmable licensing** — 9 CC variants + custom terms (AI policy, commercial use, derivatives, royalties)
- **Immutable attribution** — Remix graph stored on Starknet + IPFS, cannot be altered

---

## Tech Stack

- **Blockchain:** Starknet (ZK-rollup on Ethereum, Cairo VM)
- **Proofs:** STARK proofs, STWO prover, recursive proofs
- **Account model:** Native account abstraction (wallets are smart contracts)
- **Session keys:** SNIP-9 for gasless PIN-authenticated sessions
- **Gas sponsorship:** AVNU paymaster — creators pay zero gas
- **Storage:** IPFS via Pinata (permanent, censorship-resistant)
- **Signing:** SNIP-12 typed data (domain version 1 for ERC-721, 2 for ERC-1155)
- **SDK:** TypeScript, dual ESM+CJS, `@medialane/sdk` on npm

---

## IP Metadata Schema (OpenSea-compatible)

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "image": "ipfs://...",
  "external_url": "https://medialane.io/asset/{contract}/{tokenId}",
  "attributes": [
    { "trait_type": "IP Type", "value": "Music|Art|Photography|Writing|Film|Software|Brand|Design|Research|Education|Game|Other" },
    { "trait_type": "License", "value": "CC0|CC BY|CC BY-SA|CC BY-NC|CC BY-ND|CC BY-NC-SA|CC BY-NC-ND|All Rights Reserved" },
    { "trait_type": "Commercial Use", "value": "Allowed|Prohibited" },
    { "trait_type": "Derivative Works", "value": "Allowed|Allowed with attribution|Prohibited" },
    { "trait_type": "AI Training", "value": "Allowed|Prohibited|Allowed for non-commercial" },
    { "trait_type": "Royalty", "value": "0-25%" }
  ]
}
```

---

## Order Model (Marketplace)

Orders are SNIP-12 typed-data signed off-chain and registered onchain.

```
OrderParameters {
  offerer: ContractAddress
  offer: OfferItem { item_type, token, identifier_or_criteria, start_amount, end_amount }
  consideration: ConsiderationItem { item_type, token, identifier_or_criteria, start_amount, end_amount, recipient }
  start_time: u64
  end_time: u64
  salt: felt252
  nonce: felt252
}

OrderStatus: ACTIVE | FILLED | CANCELLED | COUNTER_OFFERED
```

---

## API Endpoints (Medialane Backend)

Base URL: configured via `NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDIALANE_BACKEND_URL`

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GET /v1/orders` | All orders (filterable by status, type) |
| `GET /v1/orders/:hash` | Single order |
| `GET /v1/tokens/:contract/:tokenId/orders` | Active orders for a token |
| `GET /v1/orders/user/:address` | Orders by wallet |
| `GET /v1/tokens/:contract/:tokenId` | Token metadata |
| `GET /v1/tokens/owner/:address` | Tokens owned by wallet |
| `GET /v1/tokens/:contract/:tokenId/history` | Provenance timeline |
| `GET /v1/collections` | All collections |
| `GET /v1/collections/:contract` | Single collection |
| `GET /v1/collections/:contract/tokens` | Tokens in collection |
| `GET /v1/activities` | Global activity feed |
| `GET /v1/activities/:address` | Activity for wallet |
